update: set -euo pipefail; v="{versions}"; rn=$(jq -r '."react-native"' "$v"); react=$(jq -r '.react' "$v"); rnw=$(jq -r '."react-native-web"' "$v"); export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8; for dir in . tier; do (cd "$dir" && npm install --save-exact --no-audit --no-fund react-native@$rn react@$react react-dom@$react react-native-web@$rnw && npm install --save-exact --save-dev --no-audit --no-fund @react-native/babel-preset@$rn @react-native/metro-config@$rn @react-native/typescript-config@$rn && cd ios && pod install); done

ios.build: set -euo pipefail; [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8; (cd ios && pod install); xcodebuild -workspace ios/ArenaReactNative.xcworkspace -scheme ArenaReactNative -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES ARCHS=arm64 -quiet build; xcodebuild -workspace ios/ArenaReactNative.xcworkspace -scheme ArenaReactNative -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath ios/build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet build

android.build: set -euo pipefail; [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a --max-workers=4

web.build: set -euo pipefail; [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; npm run build:web

android.build: set -euo pipefail; npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund; cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a --max-workers=4

ios.build: set -euo pipefail; npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund; export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8; cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace ArenaTier.xcworkspace -scheme ArenaTier -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet build

web.build: set -euo pipefail; npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund; npm run build:web

absent.macos: react-native-macos trails the core release (0.83 against 0.88) and is not in the arena yet
absent.windows: react-native-windows trails the core release (0.85 against 0.88) and is not in the arena yet
absent.linux: React Native has no Linux target
